$comment: D7 activity_error catalog: existing shared codes plus type-scoped additions. Always carries requestId when one existed. Errors never alter another match. Unsupported Node-only transport reports the activity unavailable client-side without a server round trip.
name: errors

payloadShape.message: Load the correct course before readying.

cases.when: malformed payload, unknown controls field, bad role, bad reason, non-finite steer
missing/forbidden lease action, forged admission (outside room, out of range)
sessionId no longer the live process
roomEpoch older than the current owner epoch
seq <= highest accepted for the lease (replay)
ready/leave/input signed for a previous matchId during a newer match
load handshake courseId/version/hash differs from the server course
ready before a successful load handshake
play requested during countdown/racing; client is offered watch/queue
session over capacity or admission temporarily refused
feature flag disabled, unsupported type, or no session possible

invariants: errors include requestId + serverNow so clients can correlate and keep clock samples
an error must never mutate any race other than the addressed one
full responses to refused joins carry current counts (players/queueLength/spectatorCount)
